title: Charred Sausage Skillet
description: A vegan twist on the classic sausage skillet, using flavorful charred German sausage alternatives and paired with sautéed vegetables.
instructions: Cook the charred German sausage in the skillet over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the sliced bell pepper and mushrooms to the skillet and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until tender.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Serve the sausage and vegetable mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
